observations.why: The first-person plural with a switch-decision performs a collective authority move — the speaker enacts decisional power on behalf of the group, not merely describing a preference.
Proportionality framing — quantitative benefit and cost reduction cast the decision in cost/benefit terms.
The arrow notation enacts a directed migration order under the speaker's principal; reported through Xena's rendering of Dave's decision.
Quantified performance gain framed as proportional return; reported through Xena's rendering of Dave's claim.
Setting a timeline is a scheduling authority act — the speaker allocates a time-bound commitment for the group.
